external.$comment: Counted separately and NEVER folded into in_scope or the vacuous-pass minimums. A repo whose only non-empty count is `external` has formalized nothing and must not pass.

foreign.$comment: Constants listed by an in-scope module but OWNED by an out-of-scope one -- auto-generated equation and congruence lemmas whose parent lives upstream. They are excluded from constants[] and counted here. Measured on derived-alg-geo-lean: 8 of 15346, arriving with module: Mathlib.* while modules[] listed no Mathlib module at all, so the artifact contradicted itself and I-05 was right to fail. Counted rather than silently dropped, because a filter that quietly shrinks an emission is the failure class this package exists to prevent.

counts.$comment: minimum:1 on total and in_scope is the VACUOUS-PASS GUARD. An emission of zero constants is the observable signature of a mis-scoped emitter, and it must not validate.

source_git_commit.$comment: The commit of the source checkout this sweep describes, stamped by the emitter when the working directory is a git repository. Optional for backward compatibility with pre-1.1.0 emissions; when present, `mfc bundle` refuses an environment whose root_package.rev disagrees -- the artifact-level binding that stops a stale emission from being re-bundled at a different commit (derived-alg-geo-lean #628).

scope.$comment: `topic` is a declaration this repository wrote. `external` is a constant named by a registry entry's external_decls[] and swept from outside the module scope -- a theorem someone else proved, in a package environment.json already pins by commit. The distinction is load-bearing: without it a topic could raise its own in_scope count by citing Mathlib.

doc.$comment: The declaration's doc-comment, verbatim, or null when it has none. Evidence for CLAUDE.md section 3, not documentation for a reader: section 4's hazard is IMPORTING geometry, which I-06 reads off the imports, while section 3's hazard is CLAIMING geometry you do not have -- and `abbrev NumLattice : Type := Fin 2 -> Z` imports nothing, so the false claim lives entirely in a doc-comment. null is distinct from "", which is an empty doc-comment someone wrote.

discharges.$comment: Frontier ids this declaration CLAIMS to close, from `@[discharges]`. Axis 6 was hand-edited YAML that mfc only aggregated: nothing checked that the named discharger proves anything, and unlike the faithfulness axis it carried no reviewer and no date -- an axis that looked computed while being asserted. E-12 anchors the edge here, in Environment.constants.

axioms.$comment: FULL transitive closure from Lean.collectAxioms, SORTED. collectAxioms returns them UNSORTED -- measured: [propext, Quot.sound, Classical.choice] on one decl and [Quot.sound, propext, Classical.choice] on the next in the same run. Sorting is REQUIRED for byte-reproducibility.

allOf.$comment: value_pp is statement-relevant ONLY for these kinds; anywhere else it would fold a PROOF TERM into a statement digest, making every proof edit look like a statement change.

relation_claimed.$comment: ALWAYS spelled `relation_claimed` in machine artifacts. `relation_confirmed` exists ONLY inside review/1.0. An agent reading this field reads the word 'claimed'.
